templates.title: Critical Document Review
templates.description: Review the small set of household records that should stay current, easy to find, and fast to carry.

items.text: Confirm the record pouch still contains identity, insurance, medical, and contact essentials
items.detail: Keep the set small enough to grab fast.

items.text: Replace outdated addresses, expired cards, and stale policy numbers
items.detail: Remove confusing duplicates before they become stress-state noise.

items.text: Verify another adult knows where the pouch or vault records live
items.detail: Avoid a single point of failure.

items.text: Refresh the latest home-inventory or insurance photo sweep
items.detail: Capture major purchases, remodels, or changed rooms.

items.text: Check that an offline contact list is still current
items.detail: Do not rely on one unlocked phone being available.
